notes.subject: שליש
notes.rationale: 'a third (measure)' — KJV 'in great measure', YLT 'a third time', BSB 'full measure'; shape kept as tripela hap.

notes.subject: דמעה/בדמעות
notes.rationale: Root דמע repeats in both halves (bread-of-tears / with-tears), binding the couplet; repetition kept.

translation: Yu mekim ⟨את⟩ ol manmeri bilong yu kaikai bret bilong traut, na yu givim ol drink wantaim ol traut bilong tripela hap.

tokens.gloss: yu mekim ⟨את⟩ ol manmeri bilong yu kaikai
